senses.gloss: m. (גּוּף I) the moulding or eminence of the door frame against which the door shuts, door-stop (esp. of door-ways in thick city walls &c. with reference to sacred limits in sacrificial law).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 7:12">Pes. VII, 12</cite> <he>מן הא׳ ולפנים וכ׳</he> the space of the wall inside the door-stop is subject to the laws which apply to the space enclosed by the wall.
<cite ref="Pesachim 85b:8">Ib. 85ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ עצמו</he> the stop itself and the corresponding space. Y. ib. VII, 35ᵇ <he>אגוף</he>.
